Colombian Student Association (COLSA) Scholarships COLSA SCHOLARSHIPS: Open to any member of COLSA (can be current degree-seeking or exchange students at the University of Oklahoma). The scholarships will be given in the spring semester. The recipients will be selected based on active participation and collaboration on COLSA events. COUAA SCHOLARSHIPS: COUAA will grant scholarships to qualified degree-seeking applicants based on academic merit. Last Colombian COUAA gave $12,000 dollars in scholarships to support the education of COLSA members. For more information visit http://www.couaa.com/scholarships/sholarshipInfo.html GRE WAIVER: Outstanding GRE scores will be sponsored to COLSA members applying to graduate school. This is an economic incentive to support Colombian students pursuing graduate education. Contact colsa@ou.edu to apply. SCHOLARSHIPS FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS IAC: Emergency Relief Scholarship, Former Exchange Student Scholarship , Cleo Cross Scholarship and other scholarships for international students are available for international students. For eligibility and deadlines information visit http://www.ou.edu/iss/home/left_navigation/resources/scholarships.html ICETEX: Student loans are available ICETEX is a Colombian government organization that promotes higher education through allocation of student loans. For more information visit www.icetex.gov.co
